findings.title: Person RSS endpoint loses its person identity in server mode; host-only eligibility also disagrees with profile advertising
findings.evidence: output is server; endpoint has no prerender=true, GET reads personId/personName from context.props rather than params. Installed Astro skips getStaticPaths for non-prerendered server routes and supplies {} props. Source inference: no authored/guest matches and an undefined name, not a functional person-specific feed. Independently, intended getStaticPaths covers 260 people and excludes host-only nimbinatus while all 261 profiles advertise RSS.
findings.action: Choose request-time person lookup or explicit static generation, validate unknown IDs, and align advertised feeds with contribution eligibility (including an explicit host-only decision).
findings.verificationBoundary: Not fetched or executed. Do not interpret the 260 eligible static-path candidates as current deployed feed URLs or claim a measured HTTP status.

findings.title: Watch cast uses a missing fallback image and manufactures @handles from six internal person IDs
findings.evidence: Six people have no github, so no derived avatarUrl. VideoCast emits /images/avatars/default.png, absent from public and without a matching source route/redirect; it also renders @person.data.id although that field is only a routing identifier. Eight affected guest relationships across seven distinct Watch pages. People index/detail already use honest initials.
findings.action: Use an honest no-photo fallback and display only actual social handles. Add a remote-image failure state, preserving name/profile destinations.
findings.verificationBoundary: Missing local asset/source fallback confirmed; remote image availability and actual browser failure presentation untested.

findings.title: 259 guest profiles add an empty h2 and empty ruled header inside Guest appearances
findings.evidence: People renders its labeled Guest appearances h2 then passes title='' and description='' to VideoFeed. VideoFeed always emits another h2/header and styles the empty header with padding/border.
findings.action: Omit the inner empty header or expose a headerless feed presentation; preserve the labeled outer section and video h3 hierarchy.
findings.verificationBoundary: Source-defined empty heading/spacing, not a screenshot or screen-reader observation.

findings.title: Profile counts, lists, and RSS do not enforce publication cutoffs; sitemap eligibility differs
findings.evidence: People lists all guest videos and news, non-draft articles without date filters, and all hosted shows without publish checking. Episode totals/latest thumbnails use the same unfiltered videos. Sitemap filters videos by date but does not gate shows by publish and ignores written-only contributions. Current snapshot has zero future videos/articles/news, all four shows publish=true, and all 261 people qualify for sitemap via guests/hosting; no current leaked item or sitemap omission was found.
findings.action: Use aligned publication predicates before counts, noindex, feed eligibility, recommendations and sitemap inclusion; add future recorded/live, future story, unpublished show, and written-only fixtures. Decide explicit upcoming treatment instead of presenting future items as published.

findings.title: Show summaries drop actual host names
findings.evidence: People summaries project only forename/surname. None of the 261 entries supplies those fields; every entry has name. Therefore Hosted by is absent in all six show-card instances across bketelsen/nimbinatus/rawkode, despite valid host records. Direct show detail correctly uses data.name.
findings.action: Preserve the authoritative display name through the presentation contract; do not split/rewrite authored names.

findings.title: Five authored YouTube links exist only in machine-readable metadata, not visible profile controls
findings.evidence: socialLinks covers six other link types but omits YouTube; sameAs/rel=me still include it.
findings.action: Expose valid authored destinations coherently after identity review, or document why these links are metadata-only.

findings.title: Seven website destinations use HTTP
findings.evidence: All 77 authored full URLs parse; seven website links use http. All 255 derived portrait URLs are https and use path-safe GitHub handles. No javascript/data/vbscript scheme, credential-bearing URL, malformed URL, or unsafe portrait path was found.
findings.action: Ask authors/owners to verify supported HTTPS destinations before editorial updates; do not silently assume redirects or current ownership.
findings.verificationBoundary: No HTTP requests; this is not mixed-image content and does not establish destination reachability.

findings.title: Every website/YouTube URL is promoted to Person identity; exact duplicate destinations also render twice
findings.evidence: Website and YouTube become rel=me/sameAs regardless of whether they identify a person. John Anderson website is the internal episode page, not a personal profile. icepuma and rawkode share the exact RawkodeAcademy YouTube URL. deepthi and walidshaari each render identical GitHub/Website destinations twice. Source cannot establish account ownership; a shared organization channel is not evidence of identical people.
findings.action: Separate identity links from related/organization/content links and dedupe exact destinations with combined labels. Preserve authored URLs/facts pending owner decision.

findings.title: Contributor profiles omit course, learning-path, ADR, and changelog relationships
findings.evidence: Profiles intentionally enumerate only shows/guest videos/articles/news. Current source additionally attributes four courses, four learning paths, two ADRs and 16 changelog entries, plus course modules, to these two people. Existing published-stories count describes articles/news and is numerically correct; do not relabel it as all contributions.
findings.action: Decide whether profiles should index other published work. If added, apply each collection's draft/date policy and never count all 30 module source files as published lessons.

findings.title: Brian Ketelsen appears as both host and guest in four AlphaBits casts
findings.evidence: Four video guest arrays include bketelsen, also a host on their referenced show. VideoCast renders the two arrays separately; the same person gets HOST and GUEST cards. Profile reports five guest appearances, four of them these overlaps. This is an authored relationship conflict, not permission to change historical roles.
findings.action: Preserve metadata; choose a deduplicated presentation with honest combined role labels or request an editorial decision.

findings.title: Future malformed profile content is not constrained to safe IDs/handle/URL schemes; JSON-LD raw script serialization lacks closing-script escaping
findings.evidence: id/name/handles are unrestricted strings and full links are generic z.url rather than an explicit http(s) allowlist. Person JSON-LD uses JSON.stringify with set:html. All current 261 IDs and 255 handles passed path/format scans; no script-closing or executable URL markers occur in current people sources.
findings.action: Treat as future content-contract hardening, not an active exploit finding. Validate IDs/handles/protocols and escape '<' when serializing JSON-LD; cover malicious text in fixtures.

findings.title: Rawkode profile is materially denser than ordinary guest profiles
findings.evidence: Rawkode has four show cards, 13 article rows and 37 news rows, with no profile-local section navigation or pagination. Other guest profiles have at most eight appearance cards. Density/scroll burden is inferred from source, not visually measured.
findings.action: Prioritize complete desktop/mobile keyboard/scroll review; keep all work discoverable if later introducing grouping or pagination.
